sources.title: Release GARD model on Hugging Face · Issue #4 · cvlab-kaist/GARD - GitHub
sources.snippet: The GARD model, which performs geometry-aware representation denoising for robust multi-view 3D reconstruction and image restoration, would be a great addition. A relevant pipeline tag could be "image-to-3d". Hosting on Hugging Face will give you more visibility and enable better discoverability.

sources.title: Gard | Darpa
sources.snippet: The Guaranteeing AI Robustness Against Deception (GARD) program seeks to establish theoretical ML system foundations to identify system vulnerabilities, characterize properties that will enhance system robustness, and encourage the creation of effective defenses.

sources.title: Overview of Model Garden | Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform | Google ...
sources.snippet: Jumpstart your ML project with a single place to discover, customize, and deploy a wide variety of models from Google and Google partners. Model Garden provides a collection of pre-trained models and assets that you can use to build and deploy your own AI applications.
